verdict: Thin presentation component (99 lines). c/HI-05 fix verified — all geometry math is delegated to pure helper computeSparklineGeometry (lib/sparklineGeometry.ts) which is exhaustively tested (10 cases including degenerate inputs, all-zero, target alignment, even X spacing, centered Y for flat lines). The component itself only renders SVG. 1 LOW finding: `areaD` (filled mode) constructs the close path using points[0] and points[length-1], which works for any n>=2 but produces a degenerate zero-width area when n=1 (unreachable per `values.length < 2` early return). 1 INFO finding: no aria-label on SVG when ariaLabel prop is undefined and role is 'presentation' — accessible default.

findings.failing_input: Sparkline rendered with `filled=true` and degenerate values (all equal)
findings.expected: Fill region is non-zero or explicitly suppressed
findings.actual: When degenerate=true (geometry helper returns centerY for every point), the areaD path is a thin horizontal strip from centerY down to (height-pad). This is visually valid but the helper exposes a `degenerate` flag the component never uses — could suppress the fill (or render a tinted full-height background) when degenerate.
findings.fix_sketch: Read `degenerate` from computeSparklineGeometry's return (currently destructured as `{points, targetY}` — add `degenerate`). If true and filled, either skip the fill or render a subtle full-box background. Cosmetic; defer.
findings.regression_test_idea: Visual regression (not unit-test material). The current behavior is correct, just under-leveraged.

findings.failing_input: Screen reader navigating a Sparkline without ariaLabel
findings.expected: Either role='presentation' with aria-hidden, or role='img' with mandatory aria-label
findings.actual: Defaults to role='presentation' when ariaLabel is undefined — screen readers correctly skip the SVG. Correctly handled.
findings.fix_sketch: No action needed; accessibility is correct.
findings.regression_test_idea: Test (jsdom render) that Sparkline without ariaLabel has role='presentation'.

uncertainty_notes: Component logic is straightforward; reviewed pure helper + tests. No edge cases missed.
test_coverage_gaps: No test of the Sparkline component itself (only the underlying geometry helper). A render test would assert SVG output structure (path d attribute, target line, endpoint circle visibility).
No test for ariaLabel propagation to the SVG role attribute
